The original 'real reranker/cross-encoder provider + RRF fusion deepening' item remains UNCHECKED — no real cross-encoder or evaluated RRF integration exists; only a readiness-gated config/validation + pure-rank RRF helper is delivered.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only reranker/RRF production-readiness scaffold that distinguishes the existing deterministic local reranker (is_real_rerank_model=false, in-process) from a real cross-encoder setup. build_reranker_provider_readiness / validate_reranker_provider_config classify a provider config, requiring a real provider + model + credential_source (env var NAME, never a value) + at least one eval metric (mrr/ndcg/map) and rejecting credential-shaped fields. build_rrf_fusion_plan / validate_rrf_fusion_plan describe and check a rank-based RRF plan (rank_constant/window/channels). fuse_ranked_results_rrf performs deterministic, purely rank-based RRF (1/(rank_constant+rank), no score-scale dependence, stable id tie-break, optional rank_window_size). build_rerank_pipeline_readiness aggregates into a production_ready verdict that is true only for a complete DECLARED config and always reports current_shipped_state.production_ready=false. A CLI tools/check_rerank_production_readiness.py exits nonzero on the repo default. No model call, no download, no network, no credential/.env read; original ROADMAP item stays unchecked with a checked sub-note.
implemented: backend/server.py: build_reranker_provider_readiness(config=None) distinguishing the local reranker from a real cross-encoder (requires model+credential_source+eval metric), and validate_reranker_provider_config(config) rejecting api_key/token/endpoint_url... value fields (reuses VECTOR_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS).
backend/server.py: build_rrf_fusion_plan(config=None) + validate_rrf_fusion_plan(plan) (rank_constant>=1, rank_window_size>=1, non-empty channels; default rank_constant=RRF_K=60).

backend/server.py: fuse_ranked_results_rrf(result_sets, rank_constant=60, rank_window_size=None) deterministic pure-rank RRF (1/(rank_constant+rank)), stable id tie-break, window truncation, accepts id lists or {id,rank} entries.

backend/server.py: build_rerank_pipeline_readiness(config=None) aggregating provider+RRF+metrics into production_ready (true only for a complete declared config); gates on the RAW user-supplied rrf config (build_rrf_fusion_plan sanitizes bad values, so the raw input is validated to catch errors); always reports current_shipped_state.production_ready=false and is_real_rerank_model=false.
tools/check_rerank_production_readiness.py: CLI (--config/--json); exit 0 only when production_ready, 1 otherwise (repo default -> 1), 2 on load error; no network/model call.

tests/test_rerank_production_readiness.py: 17 tests (default/local not real; real provider needs model/credential_source/metrics; credential value rejected but credential_source ok; RRF deterministic + rank-based + score-scale-independent + window truncation; invalid rank_constant/window/channels rejected; aggregate not-ready by default, ready only when fully declared, real-provider+invalid-RRF not ready, missing-metrics not ready; CLI default nonzero, complete config zero).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_rerank_production_readiness.py and tools/check_rerank_production_readiness.py.
README.md documents the gated readiness scaffold and its honesty boundary; docs/ROADMAP.md keeps the original real-reranker item UNCHECKED and adds a checked sub-note for the readiness scaffold only.

risks: production_ready=true is a CONFIG-COMPLETENESS verdict, not a connectivity/authentication/evaluation check; a fully-declared but wrong config would read as ready. It gates human intent, it does not validate a live reranker or run an eval.

fuse_ranked_results_rrf duplicates the RRF idea already embedded in the live search fusion loop; it is provided as a reusable, testable, standalone helper and is intentionally NOT swapped into the hot path in this slice (avoids behavior change without an eval).
The eval-metric list (mrr/ndcg/map) is a fixed allow-list; a declared-but-unlisted metric would not count toward readiness.
The scaffold reads only declared metadata and never resolves credential_source to a secret, so it cannot confirm a credential is present or valid.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; reranker validators reject credential-shaped value fields and the scaffold uses only a credential_source env-var NAME.
No external network calls, model calls, or model downloads were used for implementation or local tests.
